segments.text: Because the interior and exterior angle bisectors at each vertex A, B, and C are strictly perpendicular, the vertices A, B, C are the altitude feet of the excentral triangle, and the Incenter X one is the orthocenter of the excentral triangle!

segments.text: This makes reference triangle A B C the orthic triangle of its own excentral triangle, and the circumcircle of A B C is the nine-point circle of the excentral triangle. Meanwhile, connecting the excenters through the side midpoints produces the Mittenpunkt X nine, the symmedian point of the excentral triangle.
